comment: CRM sales pipeline (Opportunity Identification, mv_pipeline): one row per opportunity created Apr-2024 to Sep-2026 with its stage (Prospecting, Qualification, Proposal, Negotiation, Won, Lost), product, amount, win probability and probability-weighted value, expected and actual close, cycle time, owner RM and - for opportunities created from a signal - the source signal type, detection date and trade corridor. Win Rate % = won / (won + lost) (D21); Weighted Pipeline USD = SUM(weighted_amount_usd) over open opportunities; amounts in USD, additive across opportunities. Grain: one row per pipeline opportunity.
